task: Predict HER2 status in breast carcinoma. Classes: Negative vs. Positive. Key H&E indicators for HER2-positive disease include high-grade ductal morphology, solid architecture, conspicuous pleomorphism, apocrine features, and necrosis, while HER2-negative tumors more often lack this pattern.

classes.0: HER2-negative breast carcinoma without the characteristic HER2-enriched high-grade solid and necrotic morphology.
classes.1: HER2-positive breast carcinoma showing high-grade ductal features, solid nests or sheets, marked atypia, and possible central necrosis.
